GET /A_ServiceEntrySheet: Reads the header data from all service entry sheets.
POST /A_ServiceEntrySheet: Creates a service entry sheet.
GET /A_ServiceEntrySheet('{ServiceEntrySheet}'): Reads a specified service entry sheet.
PATCH /A_ServiceEntrySheet('{ServiceEntrySheet}'): Updates a specified service entry sheet.
GET /A_ServiceEntrySheet('{ServiceEntrySheet}')/to_ServiceEntrySheetItem: Reads the items from a specified service entry sheet.
GET /A_ServiceEntrySheetItem: Reads all service entry sheet items.
GET /A_ServiceEntrySheetItem(ServiceEntrySheet='{ServiceEntrySheet}',ServiceEntrySheetItem='{ServiceEntrySheetItem}'): Reads a specified service entry sheet item.
PATCH /A_ServiceEntrySheetItem(ServiceEntrySheet='{ServiceEntrySheet}',ServiceEntrySheetItem='{ServiceEntrySheetItem}'): Updates a specified service entry sheet item.

GET /A_ServiceEntrySheetItem(ServiceEntrySheet='{ServiceEntrySheet}',ServiceEntrySheetItem='{ServiceEntrySheetItem}')/to_AccountAssignment: Reads the account assignment(s) from a specified service entry sheet item.
GET /A_SrvcEntrShtAcctAssignment: Reads all account assignments of service entry sheets.

GET /A_SrvcEntrShtAcctAssignment(ServiceEntrySheet='{ServiceEntrySheet}',ServiceEntrySheetItem='{ServiceEntrySheetItem}',AccountAssignment='{AccountAssignment}'): Reads a specified account assignment.

PATCH /A_SrvcEntrShtAcctAssignment(ServiceEntrySheet='{ServiceEntrySheet}',ServiceEntrySheetItem='{ServiceEntrySheetItem}',AccountAssignment='{AccountAssignment}'): Updates a specified account assignment.
POST /SubmitForApproval: Submits a service entry sheet for approval.
POST /RevokeApproval: Revokes the approval of a service entry sheet.
POST /WithdrawFromApproval: Withdraws a service entry sheet from the approval process.
